name: Heroine
source:
When she was a kid she was saved by Kazuma when a demon attacked her village and killed her parents.
She was chosen to participate in a ritual that grants huge magical power, but to get it she has to receive Kazuma's semen.

In battle she is the strongest unit, since her stats can be constantly improved by having sex. She can be of any of the 8 standard classes or can chose some exclusive advanced classes after they are unlocked.

NOTE: Image shows the default appearance, but the character is totally customizable: name, body type, hair style and color, breast size, eye color, skin tone...
